extends.description: ADR-045 D5: path of a base site.yaml (relative to this file unless absolute) loaded first; this file deep-merges over it — mappings merge key by key, scalars and lists replace.

partition_profiles.description: Declarative per-partition hardware and runtime profiles. Keys are partition names.

hpc_access.description: ADR-112 D-1: the site's declared HPC access modes. Absent = undeclared (user-work lanes refuse non-admins).

login.description: The platform login; must equal extra.ssh_user.

personal.description: The login belongs to a person (shown in /umrs/sites/me and refusals).

consent_ref.description: The operator's written consent; empty = interim.

allowed_projects.description: Projects whose user work may run under this login while consent_ref is empty; [] = admins only.

signing_domain.description: ADR-112 B1.5a: the platform's DNS name; signature namespaces end in @<signing_domain>. Required when modes_allowed lists user_account.

from_address.description: The address the site sees the front connect from; written as from= on the user's authorized_keys line. Empty = no from= option.

uv_required.description: Require the FIDO user-verification flag (a PIN) on signatures.

gate_min_version.description: The oldest gate version the server accepts at verify.

profile.description: ADR-112 B2: overrides of the gate site profile the server publishes (GET /umrs/sites/me/hpc/site-profile); must name image_archive_dir for gated runs.

slurm_delegation.description: DEPRECATED (ADR-112): ignored by the backend; declare hpc_access.

service_pubkey_path.description: DEPRECATED (ADR-112): the shared delegation key is retired.

slurm_proxy_path.description: DEPRECATED (ADR-112): the shared delegation proxy is retired.

partition_choice.description: How a slurm-remote submit picks one partition from a comma list: first candidate (default) or earliest sbatch --test-only start.

preferred_partitions.description: Comma list of candidates that win an earliest-start tie before the recent-pick spreading (rccs: ng-dgx-s); a preferred candidate that starts later still loses.

network_config_dir.description: ADR-045 D1: node-local directory for podman network configs (default <graphroot parent>/networks) — keeps them off the shared $HOME.

image_archive_dir.description: ADR-045 D3: shared-filesystem directory of `podman save` archives (<name>-<tag>-<arch>.tar) that compute nodes load when an image is absent from their node-local store and no registry serves it.

egress_proxy_image.description: ADR-040 D4: in-stack egress-guard image; empty = none declared, egress_domains provisions are refused.

private_subnet_pool.description: ADR-045 D2: a.b.0.0/16 pool the wrapper allocates each job's private /24 from (job-id-derived offset), or one fixed a.b.c.0/24. Empty = 172.16.0.0/16.

account.description: Default Slurm account for workflow steps

project_accounts.description: Verified-project to Slurm account overrides; unlisted projects use account

gpu_form.description: How the HPC lane gives a step that needs a GPU its devices: cdi (NVIDIA, --device nvidia.com/gpu=all), rocm (AMD, --device /dev/kfd --device /dev/dri) or nvidia-devices (the NVIDIA device nodes + host driver libraries present on the node, for podman builds that cannot resolve CDI)

gpu_flag.description: How a step that needs a GPU asks Slurm for it when its partition profile sets no gpu_request: gres (--gres=gpu:<gpus>, default) or gpus (--gpus=<gpus>; RIKYU refuses --gres=gpu:N)

remote_enabled.description: The site's HPC lane may run uploaded step code (ADR-074); false refuses it by name unless uploaded_code is legacy_in_process

uploaded_code.description: Transition switch for sites without a live HPC lane; ignored when the lane is available

image_digests.description: ADR-112 B2: server-local JSON {ref: {arch: {image_id, archive_sha256}}} written by the converge's image stage; gated intents pin images from it

allowed_images.description: Images routing_hints.image may name besides the platform image (ADR-074 D-7)

helper_path.description: Cluster path of umrs_step_helper.py in the pinned checkout

queue_timeout.description: Max Slurm queue wait (HH:MM:SS), separate from the wall time

pids_limit.description: --pids-limit of the step container; 0 drops it (and the job's check) for a runtime that cannot apply it

cgroups.description: disabled: the venue grants the step job no cgroup to create the container's in (Slurm cgroup v2 without delegation); the container runs with --cgroups=disabled inside the job's cgroup and pids_limit must be 0

nproc_limit.description: --ulimit nproc (RLIMIT_NPROC) of the step container: a process bound without a cgroup; 0 omits it

endpoint_wait_sec.description: ADR-109 D-4: seconds a step waits for its endpoint to turn READY (queue plus model load) before it fails by name; default 2700, 0 = fail at once (UMRS_STEP_ENDPOINT_WAIT_SEC)

endpoint_max_request_bytes.description: ADR-109 D-5: largest request body a staged step may send its routed endpoint through its socket; 0 = the forwarder default, 32 MiB (UMRS_STEP_ENDPOINT_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES)

endpoint_max_response_bytes.description: ADR-109 D-5: largest single answer the forwarder passes back; 0 = default, 256 MiB (UMRS_STEP_ENDPOINT_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES)

endpoint_max_total_bytes.description: ADR-109 D-5: everything one step sends and receives through its socket; 0 = default, 4 GiB (UMRS_STEP_ENDPOINT_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES)

partition_profile.description: Declarative hardware/runtime profile for a specific Slurm partition.

litellm_image.description: LiteLLM image for this partition (e.g. a digest pin); empty keeps the wrapper's floating main-stable default. Pin only where the GPU nodes hold or can pull that digest.

gpu_request.description: How a job on this partition asks for GPUs (ADR-109 D-3): empty keeps the site-wide rule (scheduler.gpus / step_executor.gpus), none never emits --gres (RCCS ng-dgx-* reject it), gres emits --gres=<gres> (else gpu:<count>) even when the site rule says gpus: 0

gres.description: The exact Slurm gres string for gpu_request gres, e.g. gpu:PRO6000-96GB:2

exclusive.description: The partition allocates whole nodes (OverSubscribe=EXCLUSIVE); jobs there ask --exclusive

gpu_mem_util_max.description: Ceiling on a model server's --gpu-memory-utilization on this partition (0 = no cap); for GPUs shared with co-located services
